text:
lee: Heads-up — Medlio wants a hosted showcase next Wed 18:00 UTC (20m). They expect a short burst: ~90 QPS for ~8m, baseline 3	6 QPS. Can we open a temporary allowance?
maya: Quick clarifying Q: are these streaming chat sessions or single-response generates?
lee: Single-response generates, avg ~80 tokens, 4 demo clients hitting concurrently.
vikram: We can issue a scoped, time-limited key with qps cap + token budget + CIDR IP allowlist. For planning: 90 QPS * 480s * 80 tokens ~ 3.46M tokens. Recommend 1.5x buffer -> ~5.2M token budget.
provision-bot: Note: Scoped keys require explicit expiry and origin list at creation. Non-admins can't extend a TTL.
sam-sales: Procurement wants a one-line security summary and a worst-case cost estimate to approve.
maya: Ops checklist: dashboard tile for this key, pre-warm KV cache, fallback routing rule to a quantized variant, and an alert recipe.
vikram: Routing plan: primary model redwood/llm-2b, fallback redwood/llm-2b-int8. If p95 latency > 600ms for two 30s windows, new requests route to fallback. Avoids mass 429s.
lee: IPs and window: 203.0.113.12 and 203.0.113.13; window 2026-06-10T17:45:00Z -> 2026-06-10T18:30:00Z. Contact for revoke: lee@redwood + tim@medlio.com.
vikram: Proposed key policy: qps_cap=100 (buffer), concurrency_limit=8, token_quota=6_000_000, expires=2026-06-10T18:30:00Z, allow_streaming=false, origin_cidrs=["203.0.113.12/32","203.0.113.13/32"].
sam-sales: Security blurb for procurement: scoped keys are single-purpose, IP-restricted, short TTL, request-level logs tied to key fingerprint, logs retained 30 days (extendable under contract), keys revocable instantly. Customer data isolation options: hosted scoped keys vs Dedicated pools for full tenant isolation.
maya: Pre-warm request: send 15 canonical prompts to vikram by EOD Monday so we can populate the KV cache and warm kernels.
provision-bot: Action created: scoped_key_request_2113334444 by lee. Assigned to vikram. SLA: same-day during business hours.
vikram: I'll provision the key, create the dashboard panel, and add alerts. Sharing token will be via the secure channel (#sales-secure). Example curl for Medlio devs: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/llm-2b","input":"Explain the following patient note...","max_tokens":120}'
```
sam-sales: Cost estimate note: worst-case token usage ~5.2M tokens for the window. Use your customer rate card; if you want we can calculate an estimate with your per-1k-token price and send a short note.
lee: Can we do a dry-run 30m before the showcase? Prefer a quick smoke at 17:50 UTC.
vikram: Yes, I'll provision by EOD Mon and run the dry-run at 17:50. Will also disable streaming on the key as requested. Token will be redacted when posted.
provision-bot: Scoped key provisioned and shared to #sales-secure (token redacted).
sam-sales: Thanks — sending to Medlio procurement now with the security summary.
lee: Thanks team. @vikram you're the standby engineer for the run. Update this thread if anything changes.
